subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving funded accounts for {Brand} in Ghana. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the funded account, the first real-money deposit that clears, and read it back through a server-to-server postback via your MMP with a first-clearance window, so reversed and test deposits drop out before you pay. At scale we hold an eCPA on the funded account near 14 dollars [illustrative]. If it helps, I can walk you through the region-level funded-account view we are seeing in Ghana. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate funded-account validation proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the funded account near 14 dollars (MobUpps-specific cost-per-funded-account, illustrative placeholder; never an established MobUpps result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN fintech_banking_and_payments Ghana: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (funded-account optimization + S2S postback via MMP + first-clearance validation window); one illustrative figure (eCPA ~14 USD) tagged inline and in illustrative_flags; soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; native English business register (no transliteration, English-language market); no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (deposit read stated positively).
